format: UCWDC Couples and ProPro/ProAm, access to individual ballots before results
requirement: NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE: no clause restricting or granting access to individual ballots before results was found in the Couples, ProPro/ProAm or Scoring Format texts (full-text search 2026-11-23).
interpretation_notes: UCWDC ballot visibility is DanceFlow baseline policy (OD10-DF-0001). No ballot-confidentiality clause found, BUT Scoring Format p.8 says personnel who see or touch contest scoring must be trained and tested by a UCWDC Scoring Examiner, and p.1 says balloting/scrutineering/auditing is supervised by a certified Contest Coordinator: a self-designated studio-staff scoring operator may not meet that. Whether it binds DanceFlow designees is unresolved; UCWDC content designees are treated as an attested qualification. The Judge Certification Code of Conduct was not read. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-10 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Options A + C with audit logging; retrospective audit PR #795)
